name: AddNoteToOpportunity
label: Add Note to Opportunity
description: Adds a text note to a Salesforce opportunity.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.label: Opportunity ID
fields.description: The ID of the opportunity to add the note to.

fields.name: Options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Additional properties to include in the request (e.g., file attachment).

fields.name: NoteId
fields.label: Note ID
fields.description: The ID of the created note.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
